description: Performance of Structures with Clutch Inerters Subjected to Near-Field and Far-Field Seismic Excitation is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Nicholas Wierschem, University of Tennessee Knoxville (utk.edu). Damage to structures caused by earthquakes results in direct and indirect losses that inhibit a community’s ability to recover. The installation of passive control devices is one means to mitigate damage. A variety of passive control devices exist. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Clutch inerter dampers. Published 2023-11-28. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
